author: Max111111
quote: The game is very slow. I don't mind the slow pace, but sometimes it gets downright boring.Endless mundane errands: run to the store for a neighbor, run an errand for a friend, find some lost drugs, assemble a coffee table, and then take it apart because you put it together wrong.Missions are often structured according to Rockstar’s old formula: you drive across the entire map only to find out you have to turn **** graphics are good, but the image gets blurry at a distance. Even on the PS5 Pro, the game runs at 30 FPS. Graphic glitches occur occasionally.Vehicle physics are inconsistent. Some cars and planes are fun to drive, while others feel worse than in GTA V. The water physics were particularly **** game can’t decide whether it wants to be a realistic simulator or an arcade game.A 99 on Metacritic? I haven’t seen a single aspect of it that deserves a 99 yet.
